metadata.title: Existence of the Metal-Rich Stellar Halo and High-velocity Thick Disk in the Galaxy

notes: No eligible stars. The paper analyzes statistical samples of high-velocity stars selected by v_tot > 220 km s^-1 (e.g., T:p4-b10), but this kinematic threshold is not an explicit Galactic-unbound criterion, and the paper does not identify individual stars or retain any named/Gaia-identified star as a Galactic unbound candidate.
